name: AetherGrok Release Changelog
description: Central single source of truth for all AetherGrok releases, commit ranges, and download artifacts.

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.0.1 - Backend Persistent Storage & Multi-Platform CI/CD
highlights: Migrasi pengaturan (settings), daftar workspace, dan status tab/UI dari sekadar frontend localStorage ke format penyimpanan backend file murni Go (~/.grok/*.jsonl), sehingga konfigurasi dan mode persetujuan dapat langsung dibaca oleh Go backend.
Penambahan toolchain rilis otomatis dan terpusat (pnpm run release dan changelog.json).
Penyiapan pipeline GitHub Actions yang membuild installer desktop untuk macOS (.dmg) dan Windows (.exe NSIS) secara otomatis.
Penambahan flag macOS minimum deployment untuk merapikan warning compiler AVFoundation dan pemisahan build tags platform.

commits.message: feat(release): implement interactive multi-platform release manager and central changelog schema
fix(permissions): set mmacosx-version-min=10.15 for AVFoundation cgo CFLAGS to silence compiler warnings
ci: configure Wails desktop installer build workflow for macOS (.dmg) and Windows (.exe)
ci: include Go test suites and frontend build in CI pipeline
ci: add @vscode/test-electron devDependency for integration tests
fix(ci): fix typescript compilation, vitest exclusions, and package script for CI
ci: fix github actions package manager to pnpm with pnpm-lock.yaml
fix(hotkey): add darwin build tag to hotkey_test.go for cross-platform compatibility
feat(storage): implement backend persistent storage for settings, workspaces, and UI state
docs(superpowers): add architecture spec and plan for terminal split persistence, wrapping reflow, and tab border refinements

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.0.0 - Initial Official Release
highlights: Pure-Go persistent JSONL storage engine for settings, workspaces, and UI tabs
Full support for macOS (Apple Silicon arm64 & Intel x64) and Windows (x64 & arm64)
Integrated terminal dock with persistent layouts and adaptive font sizing
Wails v2 native desktop shell with light/dark studio themes and system tray integration
